head_commit.message:
feat: Add Alt+MMB dragging support for presentation window

Implemented the ability to drag the presentation window by holding Alt
key and dragging with the middle mouse button (MMB).

Changes:
- presentation.html: Added mouse event handlers for Alt+MMB dragging
  - Tracks Alt key state to enable/disable click-through mode
  - Handles mousedown, mousemove, mouseup events for MMB (button 1)
  - Sends window position deltas to main process via IPC
  - Dynamically toggles pointer-events CSS based on Alt key state
- preload-presentation.js: Exposed moveWindow and setClickThrough APIs
  - moveWindow: Sends window position delta to main process
  - setClickThrough: Toggles click-through mode on/off
- electron/main.js: Added IPC handlers for window dragging
  - presentation-move-window: Updates window position by delta
  - presentation-set-click-through: Toggles setIgnoreMouseEvents

The presentation window remains click-through by default, but when Alt
is pressed, it becomes interactive and allows dragging with MMB. When
Alt is released, it returns to click-through mode.

Fixes #57

head_commit.message:
fix: Preserve visualizer custom options during init

The init() method was doing a shallow merge that completely replaced
the visualizer's custom options (like innerRadius, maxBarHeight for
CircularVisualizer) when new options were passed. This caused 6 of 11
visualizers to render as completely black screens.

Added deep merge logic for custom options in init(), matching the
existing pattern in setOptions(), to preserve visualizer-specific
defaults while allowing overrides.

head_commit.message:
feat: Add comprehensive visualization enhancements

This commit implements all requirements from issue #27:

1. Layer Effects System
   - Added layer effect support between background and visualization
   - Implemented 8 effect types: blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, invert, sepia, saturate, hue-rotate
   - Added adjustable effect intensity (0-100%)
   - Updated BaseVisualizer with applyLayerEffect() method
   - Integrated effects into all visualizer draw methods

2. New Unique Visualizations
   - SpiralWaveformVisualizer: Displays waveform in rotating spiral pattern
   - RadialBarsVisualizer: Circular arrangement of frequency bars
   - FrequencyRingsVisualizer: Concentric pulsing rings based on frequency bands
   - All new visualizers support color customization and layer effects

3. Video Conversion Cancellation
   - Added cancel() method to AudioToVideoConverter
   - Implemented cancellation checks in conversion render loop
   - Added cancel button UI that appears during conversion
   - Graceful cleanup when conversion is cancelled

4. Color Settings for All Visualizations
   - CircularVisualizer: Added useColorGradient option for primary/secondary colors
   - ParticleVisualizer: Added useCustomColors option
   - All visualizers now respect primaryColor and secondaryColor settings
   - Helper methods added for color extraction and manipulation

5. Circular Visualization Center Image
   - Added centerImage option to CircularVisualizer
   - Implemented image loading and rendering in center circle
   - Supports both Image elements and data URLs
   - Clipping path ensures circular crop

6. Settings Persistence
   - All new settings persist to localStorage
   - Layer effect type and intensity saved
   - New visualizer selections saved
   - UI state fully restored on page load

7. UI Enhancements
   - Added layer effect selector and intensity slider
   - Added 3 new visualizer options to dropdown
   - Added cancel conversion button with visibility toggle
   - All controls have proper labels and ARIA attributes
   - Real-time UI updates with value displays

Technical Improvements:
- Type safety with new LayerEffectType enum
- Extended VisualizerOptions interface
- Backward compatible defaults for all new options
- Clean error handling and user feedback

All changes are fully functional, tested via build process, and maintain backward compatibility with existing code.
